title: 第3章
content_zh: 第3章 楚子风的身世Z市是中国南方一座小型的城市，生活在这里的人每月的工资最多也就两千，那还是非常好的单位才有，可见Z市的经济之落后。孤儿院建立在Z市的沿河地带，当楚子风回到孤儿院时是下午三点，孤儿院内不见一个人，相信全部都上学去了。“子风？你是子风？”楚子风刚进入孤儿院，就听到一个男人的声音在自己的身后响起。转过身来，只见一个身穿白色衬衫的中年男人，手中提着一个大菜篮也是刚进入孤儿院的大门。“李院长，是你呀，吓了我一跳！”李院长是孤儿院的副院长，叫李爽，四十五岁，在孤儿院已经工作有十年的时间了，平日里除了负责孤儿院的伙食之外，就是安排孤儿院中每一个孤儿的生活跟学业，至于孤儿院的钱，那都是有政府资助的，不需要太担心这里的孤儿在生活和学业上的问题。“子风，你这三个月跑到哪去了？怎么到现在才回来？……你，你怎么好像长高了！”李院长走到楚子风的身前，将手中的大菜篮放下，一脸的严肃加惊讶，对于楚子风失踪三个月，他一直都很担心，可现在楚子风回来了，他又很不爽了。“李院长，我正是长身体的年纪，高了也没什么奇怪的！”楚子风知道自己现在有着一米八的身高，这一定是修炼所造成的，如果不找个理由，还真不知道怎么解释这身高问题，因为自己以前只有一米七五的身高。“等一下……李院长，你刚才说什么，三个月？你说已经过了三个月了？”楚子风更是吃惊，自己在玄天洞府好像没呆这么长的时间呀，难道真是山中才一日，世间已千年！“你这小子，明明知道自己身体不好，还整天乱跑，害的我们都为你担心。”“其实，其实我上次跟同学们去万龙山玩的，可在途中把脚给纽伤了，所以在山下一户人家住了一段时间，帮着他们种种地，干点农活，没想到不知不觉就过了三个月！”楚子风不可能将真实情况告诉李院长，就算说了，他也不会相信呀。李院长那严肃的表情慢慢放了下来，问道：“那你的脚没事了吧？这三个月来你也没带药在身上，身体没什么问题吧？”楚子风是孤儿院的骄傲，学习成绩好的没话说，为人又非常开朗，不像其他的孤儿那般内项，所以孤儿院的工作人员都很喜欢他。“李院长，你放心好了，我没事的。你瞧，经过这段时间的劳动生活，我的身体好像还比以前好多了呢。”楚子风心里清楚的知道，自己不是身体好多了，因为修炼的关系，强化了自己的体质，那些大大小小的病魔已经被自己给驱逐走了，以后再也不会找自己了。“没事就好，没事我就放心了！”李院长一双眼睛闪过一丝的泪光，但这一幕却没有逃过楚子风的双眼。“李院长，你怎么了，为什么突然变的这么伤心？我这不是已经回来了吗！你放心，像这样的事情，我保证不会再发生了。”李院长苦苦说道：“子风，你跟我来，我有话跟你说。”楚子风不明所以然的跟在了李院长身后，可所来到的，却是正院长的房间，也就是在十八年前收养楚子风的院长房间。楚子风搞不懂，李院长怎么把自己带到正院长的房间来了，正院长不是不喜欢别人随随便便进入他的房间吗！可当楚子风刚想询问时，双眼一转，突然看见在正院长房间靠墙壁的桌子上，摆放着一个白色的瓷坛，跟一张黑白色的照片，那照片是……这一刻，楚子风仿佛联想到了什么似的，但他却不敢相信自己心中的想法，问道：“李院长，院长呢？他到哪去了？”李院长转身看着楚子风，说道：“子风呀，你刚刚回来，本来这件事我是不想现在告诉你的，可你迟早都会知道，所以，所以……”“不，不会的，我当天出门的时候院长还好好的，怎么可能……”“就在你失踪的第二天，你的老师来院里找我们，说你不见了，我们就发动了所有人去找你，也报了警，可却连你的人影都没有找到，那个时候院长的心脏就出现了点问题，直到上个月，院长……病逝了！”楚子风是院长一手带大的，如果没有院长的话，自己在十八年前就已经死了，不可能会有今天，还有机会上大学。如同晴天霹雳般，楚子风的心非常痛，眼泪忍不住掉了下来。“子风，人死不能复生，我们所有人都很坚强，我也会用毕生的时间将院长留下来的孤儿院管理好的，虽然我们不希望以后还会有孩子来到我们这里，但来到我们这里的孩子，一定不会受苦的，这是我在院长临终前许下的承诺。”李爽是个怎么样的人，孤儿院所有人都知道，他跟院长一样，为了孤儿院可以几个月不回自己的家，这份热情，其他人是办不到的。“为什么，为什么不等我回来，院长对我有大恩，为什么连最后一面也不让我见！”李院长说道：“本来院长的家人是想将院长的骨灰跟遗照带回去的，可这里是院长一生的心血，所以我恳求院长的家人，将院长的骨灰跟遗照留了下来，因为我要让院长在天之灵可以清楚的看见，他的心血，不会白费的。”顿了顿，李院长轻轻拍了一下楚子风的肩膀，说道：“子风，在院长临终前，交代了我一件事，叫我一定要找到你，将这件事亲口告诉你。”“什么事？”楚子风擦了擦眼泪问道。“是关于你的身世。”“身世？我不是孤儿吗，哪还有什么身世！”“没错，你的确是孤儿，但跟其他的孩子不一样，你不是被你的父母遗弃在我们孤儿院门口的，也不是被人送来的，而是院长当年从街上捡回来的。”“捡回来的？不对呀，院长不是这样跟我说的，他说我是被遗弃在孤儿院门口的。”“那是院长不想你董事后想的太多，毕竟一个被遗弃在街边的孩子太过可怜，他的父母也根本没管过孩子的死活，只是，院长觉得你的身世可能有点与众不同，所以在临死之前才叫我将这件事告诉你的。”“有什么不同的，被遗弃在孤儿院门口跟被遗弃在街边对于我而言，一点分别都没有。自从我懂事的那天起，就将院长当成了我的父母，将你们当成了我的家人，其他人，与我没关系。”楚子风最忌讳的，就是提到自己的父母，因为在楚子风而言，不管他们是谁，都没资格做自己的父母，否则，在十八年前，他们也不会不要自己。李院长见楚子风心中有气，这也是院长临终前最为担心的，但这件事，却不能不告诉楚子风，因为他有权知道这一切。李院长从口袋里拿出一个紫色的小盒子，将小盒子打开，里面放着一个银白色的戒指，说道：“子风，这个戒指，是当年院长捡到你的时候放在你身边的，院长相信，这个戒指中，应该隐藏了你的身世之迷。除了戒指之外，当年在你的身边，还放有十万块钱，院长也是凭着这点相信你的身世应该与众不同的，因为在十八年前，十万块钱可就好比现在的千百万了！”十八年前中国的经济才刚刚起步，在那个时候就有那么多钱，而且还放在一个被遗弃的婴儿身边，这就足以证明点什么。可楚子风却毫不在意道：“他们是想拿十万块钱作为我的抚养金吧，不过那样也好，至少钱用在了该用的地方。至于这个戒指……”楚子风接过戒指，这个戒指还挺好看的，在戒指上有一个圆形，圆形中雕刻着一个“楚”字，在“楚”字周围还雕刻着一条盘龙。“院长当年就是看到这个戒指上的‘楚’字，联想到你的父亲很可能是姓楚，才会给你取名为楚子风的，而在院长临终前交代过，不管你以后能不能找到你的父母，这个戒指，你一定要随时带在身上，不能遗失，也不能转送给其他人。”“既然是院长交代过的，那我就戴上这个戒指吧。不过，就算日后能遇到他们，我也不会认他们的，估计他们也不会想要我这个儿子吧，哈哈。”李院长摇了摇头，他早就知道楚子风会这么想，但既然院长临终前交代过自己将这件事告诉楚子风，自己也算是完成任务了，至于以后的事情，楚子风自己把握吧。“子风，你现在还是要以学业为重，其他的事情就顺其自然吧，也不要多想！大学开学的日子快到了，你去收拾一下行李，这两天就去燕京大学报道吧。”楚子风走到院长的遗照面前，轻声又有信心道：“院长，你放心，我一定不会令你失望的，等日后我事业有成，一定会回来，因为这里，才是我的家乡。”PS：新书什么最重要？当然是收藏跟投票了！请大家收藏一下，砸点票票过来！
content_en: Chapter 3 Chu Zifeng’s Life Experience Z City is a small city in southern China. The monthly salary of people living here is only two thousand at most, which is only available in very good units. This shows that the economy of Z City is backward. The orphanage was built along the river in Z city. When Chu Zifeng returned to the orphanage, it was three o'clock in the afternoon. There was no one in the orphanage. I believe everyone had gone to school. "Zifeng? Are you Zifeng?" As soon as Chu Zifeng entered the orphanage, he heard a man's voice behind him. Turning around, I saw a middle-aged man wearing a white shirt, holding a large vegetable basket in his hand who had just entered the orphanage. "Director Li, it's you, you shocked me!" Director Li is the deputy director of the orphanage. His name is Li Shuang. He is forty-five years old and has been working in the orphanage for ten years. In addition to being responsible for the meals of the orphanage, he also arranges the life and studies of every orphan in the orphanage. As for the money of the orphanage, it is all funded by the government. There is no need to worry too much about the living and academic problems of the orphans here. "Zifeng, where have you been for the past three months? Why haven't you come back until now?... You, you seem to have grown taller!" Dean Li walked up to Chu Zifeng and put down the large vegetable basket in his hand, with a serious and surprised look on his face. He had always been worried about Chu Zifeng's disappearance for three months, but now that Chu Zifeng was back, he was very unhappy again. "Dean Li, I'm at the age when I'm growing taller. It's not surprising that I'm taller!" Chu Zifeng knew that he was now 1.8 meters tall. This must be caused by cultivation. If he didn't find a reason, he really didn't know how to explain this height problem, because he used to be only 1.75 meters tall. "Wait a minute... Dean Li, what did you just say, three months? You said three months have passed?" Chu Zifeng was even more surprised. He didn't seem to have stayed in Xuantian Cave for such a long time. Could it be that it was only one day in the mountains and a thousand years in the world! "You kid, you know that you are not in good health, but you still run around all day long, which makes us all worried about you." "Actually, I went to Wanlong Mountain with my classmates last time, but I injured my ankle on the way, so I lived with a family down the mountain for a while, helping them farm the land and do some farm work. Unexpectedly, three months passed before I knew it!" It was impossible for Chu Zifeng to tell Dean Li the real situation, and even if he told him, he wouldn't believe it. Dean Li's serious expression slowly relaxed and he asked, "Is your foot okay? You haven't brought any medicine with you in the past three months. Are you okay with your health?" Chu Zifeng is the pride of the orphanage. He has good academic performance and is very cheerful. He is not as shy as other orphans, so the staff of the orphanage like him very much. "Dean Li, don't worry, I'm fine. You see, after this period of labor and life, my body seems to be much better than before." Chu Zifeng knew clearly in his heart that he was not physically better. Because of his cultivation, he had strengthened his physique, and all the diseases, big and small, had been driven away by him, and they would never come back to him again. "As long as it's okay, I'll be relieved if it's okay!" Dean Li's eyes flashed with tears, but this scene did not escape Chu Zifeng's eyes. "Dean Li, what's wrong with you? Why are you suddenly so sad? I'm back now! Don't worry, I promise that something like this will never happen again." Dean Li said bitterly: "Zifeng, come with me, I have something to tell you." Chu Zifeng followed Dean Li for no apparent reason, but what he came to was the room of the principal dean, which was the room where Chu Zifeng was adopted eighteen years ago. Chu Zifeng couldn't understand why Dean Li brought him to the principal's room. Didn't the principal dislike others entering his room casually? But when Chu Zifeng was about to ask, he rolled his eyes and suddenly saw a white porcelain altar placed on the table against the wall in the dean's room, and a black and white photo. The photo was... At this moment, Chu Zifeng seemed to think of something, but he didn't dare to look at it. He believed what he was thinking and asked: "Dean Li, where is the dean? Where has he been?" Dean Li turned to look at Chu Zifeng and said: "Zifeng, you just came back. Originally I didn't want to tell you about this now, but you will know it sooner or later, so, so... "No, it won't happen. The dean was fine when I went out that day. How could it be possible..." "On the second day after you disappeared, your teacher came to the hospital to find us and said that you were missing. We mobilized everyone to look for you and called the police, but there was no sign of you." It was found that the dean had some heart problems at that time, and it was not until last month that the dean... passed away! "Chu Zifeng was brought up by the dean. Without the dean, he would have died eighteen years ago, and there would be no chance of going to college today. Like a bolt from the blue, Chu Zifeng's heart ached so much that he couldn't help but shed tears. "Zifeng, people cannot be resurrected. All of us are strong. I will spend my whole life to manage the orphanage left by the director. Although we do not hope that any more children will come to us in the future, the children who come to us will not suffer. This is the promise I made before the director died." Everyone in the orphanage knows what kind of person Li Shuang is. Like the director, he can stay away from his home for several months for the sake of the orphanage. This passion is something that others cannot achieve. "Why, why didn't you wait for me to come back? The dean was so kind to me, why didn't he even let me see him for the last time!" Dean Li said: "Originally, the dean's family wanted to take the dean's ashes and photos back, but here is the dean's life's hard work, so
